comparison.objective: Pack four ripe peaches into tray cups without dropping them.
comparison.physical_skill: Gentle grasping, transport, contact-before-release placement, and bimanual throughput.
comparison.success_condition: All four peaches in cups; release followed by at least 1.5 cm descent permanently fails. No spec version is present.
comparison.reason: This is delicate placement and drop avoidance, unrelated to precision tuning and force-limited locking.
